decisions.reason: The flagship turnaround software has its own page and fits the firm's data-driven strategy, and its value is still uncertain one year after launch, so the option is cheap to hold and worth keeping.
This connectivity module only gets a mention, but software modules cost little to maintain and it enables the integrated apron suite, so it is worth holding while its value becomes clearer.
Billing software sits furthest from the operational core and could be folded into other offerings, but evidence after one year is too thin to justify dropping it.
Equipment monitoring builds on the firm's large installed base and supports its service business, so it carries real upside at low holding cost.
Resource management fits the integrated apron offering and it is too early to judge its value, so the option stays open.
The safety alert service matches the tower and safety focus and the firm's long sales cycles to air navigation providers, so it needs more time before its value can be judged.
